es.description: Aplica commits concretos de un PR o rama mediante cherry-pick a la rama actual
howToAsk: /git--cherry-pick-pr trae solo el commit del fix de seguridad de ese PR
/git--cherry-pick-pr aplica dos commits de la rama release a mi rama
/git--cherry-pick-pr necesito llevar un cambio concreto sin fusionar todo el PR
es.title: Cherry-pick de una PR
es.summary: Trae commits concretos de una PR o de otra rama a tu rama actual, eligiéndolos tú y ayudándote a resolver conflictos.

howToAsk: /git--cherry-pick-pr bring just the security fix commit from that PR
/git--cherry-pick-pr apply two commits from the release branch to mine
/git--cherry-pick-pr grab one specific change without merging the whole PR
en.title: Cherry-pick from a PR
en.summary: Brings selected commits from a pull request or another branch into your current branch, and helps resolve any conflicts.
